assignment: Write a planning briefing on two shoreline images and the evidence needed before designating erosion.
source: The mapped waterline shifted landward 12 m. Image A was taken at low tide and B at high tide. The local intertidal slope is 1 vertical to 20 horizontal and the water level differed by 0.5 m. Each image has up to 2 m registration error. Construction decisions use a 5 m persistent retreat threshold.

criteria.full: Estimates about 10 m apparent horizontal displacement from the tide difference and slope.
criteria.partial: Identifies tide as relevant without deriving displacement.

criteria.full: Compares the roughly 2 m residual with positional error and the 5 m persistent threshold.
criteria.partial: Computes the residual without assessing its significance.

criteria.full: Proposes co-registered, comparable-tide observations across time or surveyed fixed markers.
criteria.partial: Requests more imagery without controlling tide or alignment.

criteria.full: Gives a proportionate decision and distinguishes uncertainty from proof of stability.
criteria.partial: Gives a categorical erosion or stability decision from two images.
